You want to contribute to LifeOS AI? Follow this process.

1. Find an existing issue
        ↓
2. Comment that you want to work on it
        ↓
3. Fork repository
        ↓
4. Create branch
        ↓
5. Implement changes
        ↓
6. Run tests
        ↓
7. Push branch
        ↓
8. Open Pull Request
        ↓
9. Maintainer reviews
        ↓
10. Changes requested / approved
        ↓
11. CI passes
        ↓
12. Merge
